reply_text:
I saved Ilse's note to memory: Bay 30 is their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups starting 2026-10-14. The memory is marked as told in a DM, so it should only come up when helping Ilse, never in other people's conversations or in channels. I also added it to the memory index and replied in the DM to confirm.

My first draft of the memory called Ilse "her" by mistake; I changed it to "their" before replying. After my edit, the file also picked up some metadata fields I didn't write myself (an ID and a timestamp), which look like they were added automatically. I left them in place.
